# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Palette ramps and brand — 17 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 9 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Geometry — 5 tokens; Border — 4 tokens; Layout — 11 tokens.

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--void);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the core value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-system-title);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-command);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `system-title` | `.system-title`, `--text-system-title` | 44px / 46px | 700 | `command` | The system mark on landing and portal screens. Uppercase, expanded tracking, once per screen. |
| `operator-title` | `.operator-title`, `--text-operator-title` | 22px / 26px | 600 | `command` | Operator identification in the masthead and on entry. Always carries the operator code after the double slash. |
| `section-header` | `.section-header`, `--text-section-header` | 12px / 16px | 600 | `command` | Section identifier, uppercase, usually sitting on a Phantom Line. The one place uppercase is routine. |
| `page-title` | `.page-title`, `--text-page-title` | 26px / 32px | 600 | `interface` | The working-context title of a workspace. |
| `panel-header` | `.panel-header`, `--text-panel-header` | 15px / 20px | 600 | `interface` | Panel, card and drawer headings. Short and direct. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 14px / 22px | 400 | `interface` | Interface copy, in platinum. Measure capped at 72 characters. |
| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 13px / 20px | 400 | `interface` | Dense rows, card descriptions, secondary copy. |

| `readout` | `.readout`, `--text-readout` | 40px / 42px | 500 | `technical` | Instrumentation numerals. Tabular figures, tight leading, a micro-label beneath — never a marketing metric. |

| `telemetry` | `.telemetry`, `--text-telemetry` | 12px / 18px | 500 | `technical` | The telemetry rail, meter readouts, log lines. |
| `micro-label` | `.micro-label`, `--text-micro-label` | 11px / 14px | 600 | `technical` | Engraved identifiers on panel architecture: STATE, TARGET, BUILD, NODE. Used sparingly — this is the marking on the machine, not a heading. |

### Font files

Fonts: one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`) and upload it as an asset where you use it (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) — HTML/CSS: an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule; a Slides deck: write `fonts/<id>` = `{"family":"<family>","src":"<the url the upload returned>"}`. `tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that inlines it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

## Spacing

A 4px base grid. Dense does not mean cramped: density changes the step you reach for, never the legibility of what sits in it.

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap; the inset on a micro-label; a rail's breathing room. |
| `space-2` | 8px | Inside a control; between adjacent controls; dense table cell padding. |
| `space-3` | 12px | Standard row padding; compact component interiors. |
| `space-4` | 16px | Card and panel padding; the default gap between modules. |
| `space-6` | 24px | Between content groups; comfortable panel padding. |
| `space-8` | 32px | Between sections; the workspace gutter. |
| `space-12` | 48px | Major page divisions. |
| `space-16` | 64px | Command region separation on the home workstation. |
| `space-24` | 96px | Landing and operator-selection negative space. Darkness is structure — this step is where it lives. |

## Radius

Phantom geometry is cut, not rounded. Radii stay near zero; the recognizable corner is the Phantom Cut, which is a chamfer rather than a radius.

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-none) */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-none` | 0 | Panels, rails, tables, frames — anything structural. |
| `radius-xs` | 2px | Buttons, inputs, toggles and small controls. |
| `radius-sm` | 3px | Cards and menus. The largest radius in the system. |
| `radius-pill` | 999px | Status dots and the toggle knob. Nothing else. |

## Geometry

The Phantom Cut: a diagonal chamfer on the upper-right or lower-left corner, cut with clip-path. Applied to important panels, operator cards, command modules, modal architecture and large buttons — never to every element.

### Use

```css
/* var(--cut-sm) */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cut-sm` | 10px | Buttons and compact cards. |
| `cut-md` | 16px | Standard panels, tool cards, command modules. |
| `cut-lg` | 28px | Modal architecture, hero panels, the operator matrix. |
| `rail-width` | 3px | The operator-energy rail on a selected card, row or nav item. |
| `node-size` | 5px | The gold node in a Phantom Line. |

## Layout

Five zones: masthead, navigation rail, workspace, context panel, telemetry rail.

### Use

```css
/* var(--masthead-height) */
```

### Tokens (11)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `masthead-height` | 56px | The command masthead. Controlled height — part of the machine, not a website header. |
| `rail-expanded` | 248px | Navigation rail with icon and label. |
| `rail-collapsed` | 64px | Navigation rail as icons only. |
| `context-panel` | 360px | Right-hand context panel. Collapses when unnecessary. |
| `telemetry-height` | 32px | The bottom system telemetry rail. |
| `row-comfortable` | 48px | Comfortable density: landing, operator selection, settings, onboarding. |
| `row-standard` | 40px | Standard density. The default for dashboards, tool browsers and the command center. |
| `row-dense` | 32px | Dense: logs, networking, diagnostics, forensic tables, inventory. |
| `content-max` | 1680px | Maximum workspace width; technical tables may exceed it and scroll. |
| `measure` | 72ch | Maximum line length for interface copy. |
| `blur-glass` | 14px | Backdrop blur behind smoked glass. Subtle, and always with an opaque fallback. |
